data.status: in the design and planning stages
data.short_description: Buffalo-inspired chicken wing chain Atomic Wings is planning its first Ohio location near Ohio State University's campus. The franchise owner confirmed a target opening before the college football season, though the project is currently in design and planning. The menu will feature fresh never-frozen halal wings, tenders, sandwiches, and flavored dirty sodas.

data.status: aiming for a July opening date
data.short_description: Owner Sergio Barbone submitted a liquor license application for Osteria Gilberto, an Italian concept coming to Lincoln Park's Webster and Magnolia corner. Barbone declined to share further details at this time but is targeting a July opening. He also owns Bakehouse Chicago, with locations in Lakeview, Roscoe Village, and Southport.

Owner Alex Lewis is opening a wine-and-cheese concept beside Marblehead House of Pizza, featuring small plates, charcuterie, grilled cheeses, and zero-proof options in an inclusive, all-ages atmosphere. Lewis is currently hiring and building excitement through weekly tastings and pairing events ahead of the grand opening. The timeline remains dependent on final preparations and hiring.

Operators Tina McCarthy, Chad Ingram, and Rob Johnston are developing a boutique hotel in downtown Aiken incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building and adjacent property. The four-story new build will include 84 rooms, suites, extended-stay residences, a lobby bar, and garden courtyard, while the historic renovation will house a restaurant, bar, meeting rooms, and fitness space. The restaurant name and menu are still being finalized.
